targets.rawSql: SELECT level as "Ethos Level", creator_count as "Creators" FROM public.creator_ethos_score_distribution ORDER BY creator_count DESC;
SELECT creator_address, ethos_score, ethos_level, ethos_score_source, market_cap_usd FROM public.creator_ethos_projection ORDER BY ethos_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100;
SELECT snapshot_date as time, 'average' as metric, AVG(ethos_score) as value FROM public.creator_ethos_daily_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('day', snapshot_date) as time, width_bucket(COALESCE(ethos_score, 0), 0, 100, 10) as bucket, COUNT(*) as value FROM public.creator_ethos_daily_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_date as time, ethos_score_source as metric, AVG(ethos_score) as value FROM public.creator_ethos_daily_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ethos_score_source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

WITH first_seen AS (SELECT creator_address, MIN(snapshot_date) as first_date FROM public.creator_ethos_daily_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY 1) SELECT snapshot_date as time, 'retained' as metric, COUNT(DISTINCT s.creator_address) as value FROM first_seen f JOIN public.creator_ethos_daily_snapshots s ON s.creator_address = f.creator_address AND s.snapshot_date >= f.first_date WHERE f.first_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_date as time, 'p50' as metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ethos_score) as value FROM public.creator_ethos_daily_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT snapshot_date as time, 'p90' as metric, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ethos_score) as value FROM public.creator_ethos_daily_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1, 2;
